## Library loading

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("table1")
library("ggridges")
library("here")

if (!requireNamespace("VennDiagram", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("VennDiagram")
}
library("VennDiagram")
```

## Load data

To describe the data for analysis, both joined data frames are loaded for further exploration.

```{r}
inner_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
left_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_left.tsv"))
```

## Medians by region throughout the decades

To describe the current situation across regions, each country's data was summarised over the years from 1950-2020. For every country, the median under-5 mortality rate, measles vaccine coverage, and stunting prevalence across the available years were calculated, giving one value per country.

By using the median, the influence of single unusual years is reduced and sparse data, like stunting prevalence, is used to describe the decade. The country values were also summarised by region, including the number of countries with missing data for each variable.

```{r}
# Info presented in a tidy table
left_df |>
  filter(between(year, 1950, 2020)) |>
  group_by(country_code, region) |>
  summarise(Mortality_rate = median(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
            Measles_coverage = median(measles_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            Stunting_prevalence = median(stunting_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
            ungroup() |>
  mutate(who_region = factor(region)) |>
  table1(x = formula(~ Mortality_rate + Measles_coverage + Stunting_prevalence | who_region),
         data = _)

# Median per country
country_medians <- left_df |>
  filter(between(year, 1950, 2020)) |>
  group_by(country_code, region) |>
  summarise(Mortality_rate = median(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
            Measles_coverage = median(measles_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            Stunting_prevalence = median(stunting_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Mortality_rate,
                        Measles_coverage,
                        Stunting_prevalence),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  mutate(variable = str_replace(variable, "_", " "))

# Boxplot of country medians per region
country_medians |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value,
             y = fct_rev(region),
             fill = region)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2,
              size = 1,
              alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Country medians by WHO region",
       x = "Median value per country",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

## Data coverage

To get an overview of the data available for analysis, the number of countries, the range of years and the number of values for each variable were first counted.

To see how the data points are shared between datasets, each data point was defined as a country-year, and a Venn diagram was made to show how many country-years are found in which datasets. The data points found in all three datasets are the ones being used for further analysis.

Finally, a heatmap was made to show how coverage is distributed over time and across WHO regions. 

```{r}
# Simple description of the data found
left_df |>
  summarise(countries = n_distinct(country_code),
            first_year = min(year),
            last_year = max(year))

# Number of values per variable
left_df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mortality_rate,
                        measles_coverage,
                        stunting_prevalence),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  count(variable)

# Which country-year appears in which dataset
coverage_data <- bind_rows(mortality_clean |> 
                             select(country_code, year) |> 
                             mutate(dataset = "Mortality"),
                           measles_clean |> 
                             select(country_code, year) |> 
                             mutate(dataset = "Measles"),
                           stunting_clean |> 
                             select(country_code, year) |> 
                             mutate(dataset = "Stunting"))

# Region of each country
region_info <- left_df |>
  count(country_code, region) |>
  select(country_code, region)

# Heatmap of data coverage per region and year
region_sizes <- region_info |>
  count(region, name = "n_countries")

coverage_data |>
  left_join(region_info, by = "country_code") |>
  drop_na(region) |>
  count(year, dataset, region) |>
  left_join(region_sizes, by = "region") |>
  mutate(share = n / n_countries * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = region,
             fill = share)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Share of countries with data per year by WHO region",
       x = "Year",
       y = NULL,
       fill = "% of countries") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# Venn Diagram for shared data points
mortality_venn <- mortality_clean |> 
  mutate(venn_name = str_c(country_code, year, sep = "_")) |> 
  pull(venn_name)

measles_venn <- measles_clean |> 
  mutate(venn_name = str_c(country_code, year, sep = "_")) |> 
  pull(venn_name)

stunting_venn <- stunting_clean |> 
  mutate(venn_name = str_c(country_code, year, sep = "_")) |> 
  pull(venn_name)

venn_plot <- venn.diagram(x = list(Mortality = mortality_venn,
                                   Measles = measles_venn,
                                   Stunting = stunting_venn),
                          filename = NULL,
                          fill = c("#440154", "#21908C", "#FDE725"),
                          alpha = 0.3,
                          main.fontfamily = "sans",
                          main.fontface = "bold",
                          fontfamily = "sans",
                          cex = 1,
                          cat.cex = 1,
                          cat.fontfamily = "sans",
                          cat.fontface = "bold",
                          cat.pos = c(-20, 20, 180),
                          cat.dist = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
                          main = "Available data points in each dataset")
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(venn_plot)
```
